instructions.name: registrar
docs: Registers proof of existence of a document by its SHA-256 hash.
The document itself is never sent: only the hash and a descriptive name/type.

accounts.name: assinante
docs: The signer pays the rent for the record account, with no Niara
custody in between.

accounts.name: assinatura
docs: `init` fails if the PDA already exists: a registered hash can never be
overwritten or back-dated.

errors.name: HashInvalido
errors.msg: Hash invalido: o hash SHA-256 nao pode ser todo zero

errors.name: NomeInvalido
errors.msg: Nome do documento vazio ou acima do limite de bytes

errors.name: TipoInvalido
errors.msg: Tipo do documento vazio ou acima do limite de bytes

types.name: Assinatura
docs: Proof of existence and authorship of a document. Stores only the SHA-256
hash; the document itself never goes on-chain ("your assets, truly yours":
the file stays with the customer).
Complementary evidentiary record: it does NOT replace a notary or ICP-Brasil.

fields.name: assinante
docs: Self-custody wallet that signed the registration transaction.

fields.name: hash_documento
docs: SHA-256 hash of the document, computed in the customer's browser.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Cluster Unix timestamp at registration time.

fields.name: slot
docs: Slot in which the record landed: an extra anchor for time ordering.

types.name: DocumentoRegistrado
docs: Same logical shape as the EVM contract's `DocumentoRegistrado` event, so the
Niara Register indexer can handle both networks with the same schema.

constants.name: ASSINATURA_SEED
docs: PDA seed of each record: ["assinatura", hash_sha256].
Because the PDA address is derived from the hash itself, there is at most
ONE account per document. That is what guarantees a single record per hash
(parity with `DocumentoJaRegistrado` in RegistroAssinaturas.sol).
